AST Ambiente Soluções e Tecnologia.note: AST Ambiente is an independent private company established in 2008 with headquarters and a factory in Portugal and operations in Brazil under AST Brasil.

Acquaplant Tecnologia Ambiental.note: There is no record of Acquaplant Tecnologia Ambiental being acquired, and the company continues to operate as an environmental solutions and laboratory analysis provider in Brazil.

Aspen Tratamento de Água Ltda..note: The company operates independently as an active provider of water treatment systems and has no verifiable record of being acquired.

BWT Projetos e Sistemas de Engenharia.note: The company was founded in 2016 and remains an active, independent provider of water and wastewater treatment engineering systems in Brazil.

Clear Water Tratamento de Água.note: The company trades under the registered corporate name Clearwater Comércio e Serviços LTDA and remains active under independent operation.

Enfil S/A Controle Ambiental.note: The company remains independently operated by its founders, Franco Tarabini and Diego Tarabini, having successfully emerged from judicial reorganization in 2024.

Filterinter Enterprises LTDA.note: Filterinter Enterprises LTDA remains an active, independent company operating under its own brand since its establishment in 1987.

Foxwater Tratamento de Efluentes Atmosfé.note: The company remains an independent, family-founded or privately held organization operating actively under its original brand since 1992.

H2O Engenharia Química e Ambiental.note: The company remains an independent privately owned entity in Brazil and is fully operational.

Hoken International Company Ltda..note: The company was founded in 1997 by Hélio Tatsuo Yostsui and continues to operate as an independent water purification and franchise business in Brazil.

BR Fish Aquarismo.note: BR Fish Aquarismo is a family-owned manufacturer of reverse osmosis filters and an online retailer operating independently.

On-Lab Assistência Técnica Laboratorial.note: OnLab is an independent provider of laboratory water purification systems established in 2010.
